title: A pair to give away
summary: The boot rep gives you a brand-new pair to give to a young fan, on camera, for the advert. You know which fan. The rep has a different one in mind. A season on, whose feet are they on?

ends.title: Her boots
ends.text: The boot company wanted a kid for their advert and you picked the one who'd always been at the barrier. She plays in them till the studs are gone.

ends.title: The advert kid
ends.text: The boot company picked the kid for the advert. He was very good on camera. You never saw him again.

beats.title: A box of boots

event.title: A box of boots
event.speaker: sponsor
setup: {sponsor.name} has a box of brand-new boots and a camera crew. "You give these to a young fan, on camera, at the barrier on Saturday. We've picked a lad. He's an actor. Very good face."

say: "It's an advert. It has to look right." You can think of exactly who should have them. {kidfan.name}, every week, at the barrier, in boots with tape round them.

replies.label: "I'm giving them to the girl at the barrier. Film that."
"Bring two boxes. One for the advert, one for her."

her.text: {kidfan.short} opens the box at the barrier and doesn't say anything for ages. The crew films it. It's the best thing in the advert, and nobody acted.

both.text: The actor gets a box on camera. Afterwards, off camera, {kidfan.short} gets one too. She takes the tape off her old ones there and then.

actor.text: The actor is very good. He does the face. {kidfan.short} watches from three places down the barrier, in her taped boots.

beats.hint: The boot rep has a box

beats.title: The studs

event.title: The studs
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A season on. {kidfan.short} is at the barrier with a pair of boots held up over her head.
{if arc.path=='her'}They're the advert boots. The studs are worn flat.{/if}{if arc.path=='actor'}They're new ones, from the shop. Her mum saved up.{/if}

outcomes.text: You sign them. She says she scored eleven goals in them. You believe her. You get {sponsor.short} to send another pair.
You sign them. Her mum says thank you, quietly, for something you didn't do.
She waves the flat studs at you. She's grown out of them, she shouts. She's still wearing them.
She waves back. The advert's on the telly that night, with the actor.

beats.hint: A season on, a pair of boots
